uri.title: Redis URI
uri.description: redis:// or rediss:// endpoint with Redis Search and driver write permissions. URL-encode credentials and configure read/write timeouts.

schema.description: Destination SQL schema. Created if needed.

use_stream_namespace.description: Use a stream's namespace as its SQL schema when nonempty, otherwise use the configured schema.

max_state_bytes.description: Limit for deferred state acknowledgements during staged Overwrite. States are spooled to a temporary file.

database_options.description: Trusted ADBC database options. Connection and transaction settings cannot be overridden.
